crossRefs.note: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

parallels.note: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

translations.web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
translations.bsb: And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
translations.kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
translations.asv: And straightway the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
